name: keyboard-follow-ring
description: The workbench follows the focus ring with the keyboard of the window: it sends surfaceFocus for the surface of the ring, decided at the release of a press, shows and hides a native modal (the host answers the show with the aligned rectangle of the modal), and answers each placement and responder move; the host answers the other calls with null, and the replies of the keyboard calls that a test holds are released by that test.
reason: The keyboard call and the modal need a window, and the Go producer runs only the log and workspace calls without a window (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
